$comment: The brand in one place. Replace src/brand/logo.svg (the silhouette: one colour, viewBox cropped tight) and run `npm run brand`: the PWA icons, the favicon, the notification badges, the launch screen, the loader and the logo in the app all follow. `eyes` are drawn over it and blink in the loader: centre and diameter in % of the logo's width and height ([] for none).
$splash: How Android draws the PWA splash, measured on a phone (Android 14, Chrome WebAPK): the icon this wide in px, and its centre this far above the middle of the page (half the status bar). The launch screen copies it, so the hand-over does not jump.
